purpose: Typed book no-trade overlay. Each date blocks the whole book session: no entries, no adds, every leg flat before the prior session's own-flat deadline. These are digest-pinned policy restrictions on the book; they do not assert that any product's exchange was closed, and they do not edit or reinterpret the immutable D19 date-membership file.

d19_source.relationship: Overlay dates are also present in D19 as sub-deadline closes; the overlay is the typed book restriction that D19 cannot express.

dates.label: Good Friday 2023
dates.reason: Equity index matching ends 09:15 ET and FX 11:15 ET on the D19 secondary record; no deadline row can express a close before 12:59 ET, so the book session is blocked.
